incident: Phase 4-5 scripts claimed as implemented but were never coded
root_cause: ROADMAP.md promised 177 modules. Phase 4-5 script files exist (phase4_*.py, phase5_*.py) but contain no implementation logic. CLAUDE.md implementation status table previously claimed status without verifying actual code existed.
fix: Audit completed. Created docs/phase-status.md with explicit ✅ Real vs ❌ Stub labels. Added session-start hook to show phase status. Created bd-002 to track Phase 4-5 implementation when it starts.
lesson: Script file existence ≠ working code. Always verify implementation status by reading actual code, not just file listing. Aspirational planning docs should be marked as such (FUTURE_PLAN.md, not ROADMAP.md).
